meaning.en: Read the process health envelope and service version; not dependency readiness.
meaning.fa: خواندن وضعیت فرایند و نسخه سرویس؛ بدون تضمین آمادگی وابستگی‌ها.

GET /health.scope: One deployment/sandbox release catalog; no organization/project column. Gateway and deployment routing are separate verification.

permissions.meaning: No enforced user permission, membership or tenant authorization in read handlers. Malformed forwarded UUID returns 400 locally. Closed is not an audience ACL.

filters.meaning: No query filters. Hardcoded service version 0.1.1; Cargo package version is 0.1.0.

inputs_outputs.meaning: OpenAPI is a raw document; other reads use {status,message,data}. Slug is a string, release/service IDs UUIDs. version_code numeric, version_name display string; scope Public/Closed, channel Release/PreRelease. Dates are naive timestamps.

lifecycle.meaning: Reads do not mutate. Missing/inactive selected entity is 404; malformed release UUID 400. Service detail may have null latest; version UUID lookup ignores parent activity. No generic CRUD/deletion endpoint.

relationships.meaning: Release.service_id refers to Version catalog service UUID. Control project slug selects release serviceSlug within its sandbox namespace, not an IDP/Agentic project UUID. Namespace-local publisher Secret and external HTTPS artifact are separate authorities; live provisioning/download/read-back are unverified.

remaining_gates: canonical and deployed source reconciliation
Control sandbox routing/credential provisioning and durable publication read-back

meaning.en: Publish or update sandbox APK release metadata with a server-only credential and raw identity receipt.
meaning.fa: ثبت یا به‌روزرسانی فراداده انتشار APK سندباکس با اعتبارنامه سمت سرور و رسید خام شناسه.

POST /api/v1/apk/releases.scope: One deployment/sandbox release catalog; no organization/project column. Gateway and deployment routing are separate verification.

permissions.meaning: Exact per-deployment APK_PUBLISH_TOKEN >=32 bytes; 503 if unavailable, 401 if mismatch. Header identity or remembered role cannot substitute.

filters.meaning: Existing service by exact slug, existing release by service UUID plus version string; lower-code retry does not replace a newer same-version record.

inputs_outputs.meaning: CamelCase serviceSlug/appName/version/versionCode/downloadUrl; positive i64, bounded text, HTTPS without URL credentials. Raw {status,id} receipt, no data envelope.

lifecycle.meaning: Local transaction-scoped per-slug advisory lock serializes first creation and updates; stable identity, preserved created_at, older same-version code no-op, equal code may update metadata. Existing parent status/title unchanged; release activated. Real insert failure rolls back both service and release; seeding preserves existing catalog. Canonical still lacks this serialization.

relationships.meaning: Release.service_id refers to Version catalog service UUID. Control project slug selects release serviceSlug within its sandbox namespace, not an IDP/Agentic project UUID. Namespace-local publisher Secret and external HTTPS artifact are separate authorities; live provisioning/download/read-back are unverified.
